title: Base change of the orientation and of the tensor map
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $X,Y,Y'$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$, and let $v:Y'\to Y$ be any $k$-morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Put $X'=X\times_Y Y'$ with projections $u:X'\to X$, $f':X'\to Y'$ [def-pc-base-change].

Use either (i) a finite commutative ring $A$ killed by a power of $\ell$, with the ordinary constant-$A$ pro-etale module derived categories and bounded constructible finite-Tor subcategories of [det-sp-finite-general-ring], or (ii) a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with ring of integers $\mathcal O_E$, $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n$, and the ordinary derived categories of varying-coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian] and their full uniformly bounded constructible finite-Tor subcategories [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. No normalization of an input tower is assumed. Write $B$ for $A$ or for the coefficient system $A_\bullet$, and $\mathcal C_T(B)$ for the corresponding constructible finite-Tor category. Pullbacks, tensor products, shifts and twists are those of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-derived-tensor, def-coefficient-twists-detailed], with the finite-$A$ twists specified in [det-sp-finite-general-ring] and tower operations as in [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels]. All tensor products here are ordinary derived tensor products over $B$, not completed tensor products.

Let $F_f=Rf_{!,B}\dashv G_f=f_B^!$ be the constructible adjunction, and put $\omega_{f,B}=G_f B_Y$. At finite coefficients use [det-sp-finite-general-ring, def-pur-co-smoothness]; for towers use [det-sp-tower-gluing]. Let $\beta:v_B^*F_f\xrightarrow{\sim}F_{f'}u_B^*$ be compact-support base change and define $e_K:u_B^*G_fK\to G_{f'}v_B^*K$ to be the adjoint transpose of
$$v_B^*\varepsilon_{f,K}\circ\beta_{G_fK}^{-1}:F_{f'}u_B^*G_fK\to v_B^*K.$$
At finite coefficients these are the canonical smooth exceptional exchanges of [thm-pur-cohomological-smoothness, def-exchange-projection]; for towers they are those of [det-sp-tower-exceptional-bc]. Identify $v_B^*B_Y=B_{Y'}$ and write $e_1:u_B^*\omega_{f,B}\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_{f',B}$ for the unit component. Let $L_{f,B}=B_X(d)[2d]$ and $a_{f,B}:L_{f,B}\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_{f,B}$ be the inverse of the diagonal orientation: [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object, det-sp-finite-general-ring] at finite coefficients and [det-sp-tower-gamma](1) for towers. Let $t_{f,K}:f_B^*K\otimes^L\omega_{f,B}\to G_fK$ be the transpose of inverse projection formula followed by $1_K\otimes\varepsilon_{f,1}$, as in [def-pur-co-smoothness, det-sp-finite-general-ring, det-sp-tower-gamma](2). Define $\gamma_{f,B}(K)$ by twist reassociation followed by $1\otimes a_{f,B}$ and $t_{f,K}$, as in [def-pur-smooth-purity-map, det-sp-finite-general-ring, det-sp-tower-gamma]. Then:

1. Under the canonical twist/pullback identification $u_B^*L_{f,B}=L_{f',B}$, one has $e_1\circ u_B^*a_{f,B}=a_{f',B}$.
2. For every $K\in\mathcal C_Y(B)$, under $u_B^*f_B^*=f_B'^*v_B^*$ and the monoidal pullback comparisons, one has
$$e_K\circ u_B^*t_{f,K}=t_{f',v_B^*K}\circ(1_{f_B'^*v_B^*K}\otimes e_1).$$

Consequently, with the same source identifications,
$$e_K\circ u_B^*\gamma_{f,B}(K)=\gamma_{f',B}(v_B^*K).$$

proof.text: For finite coefficients, apply the normalized finite orientation base-change theorem in the ordinary etale derived category. Apply the comparison functor to obtain clause (1).

For finite coefficients, reuse CanonicalSmoothBaseChange.dualizing_tensor_base_change, the proved dualizing-complex tensor/counit base-change calculation. Express smoothTensorDualityMap as the braiding followed by dualizingComplexTensorMapOfIsIso. Monoidality of pullback carries the braiding through its tensor comparison. Braiding naturality and the tensor interchange law give exactly clause (2) in the displayed factor order; no constructibility hypothesis is needed for this calculation.

Expand the finite gamma into tensoring alpha inverse followed by smoothTensorDualityMap. Substitute step 2. Naturality of the monoidal pullback comparison and of tensoring the square pullback map moves u*(alpha inverse) next to e_1. Substitute step 1 and use functoriality of tensor. The resulting comparison is definitionally ordinaryFiniteTwistedPullbackComparison. Apply the site comparison functor to the two ordinary equations to finish finite_factors.
Apply tower_factor_orientation to get s,t, their two prescribed finite WordComparison equations, and the actual tower orientation square.
Apply tower_factor_tensor using s and its unit WordComparison to get the tower tensor/counit square at every K.

Expand both gamma maps with towerGamma_eq. Map composition through u*, substitute the tensor square, and move u*(identity tensor orientation) through towerTensorComparison using its naturality. Functoriality of the tensor bifunctor combines u*orientation with the unit exchange. Substitute the orientation square and split tensoring t followed by the primed orientation. This proves the gamma square; pair it with the tensor square and the orientation witnesses.

Old steps map to new nodes: 1 to the cube, 2 to the section DNC/integration square, 3-4 to the scalar/tower transport, 6 to the ctf pullback domains, 7 to the abstract tensor-counit calculus. Old step 5 verifies the hypotheses of the existing lem-sp-compact-projection-base-change, whose statement already fixes the maps; old step 8 is the assembly. I recomputed the cube pasting (p2 q = u p2', both decompositions give the square W' to X over X' to Y with base f u = v f'; pullback along Delta' gives the kappa equation). I checked the section square against thm-pur-dnc-invariance (any b, no flatness) and against the base-change clause of cor-pur-vector-bundle-purity. I checked the scalar cancellation, with the mixed square of lem-pur-dnc-coefficient-transport for g0=f, h=v, B=A. I checked the tower joint injectivity: single-complex full faithfulness plus exact evaluation, not a claim of derived faithfulness. I recomputed all transposes in the counit calculus; it needs invertibility only at the three pairs and none of e1. Edge cases checked: identity v, d=0, empty schemes, A=0, ramified E (levels A_{E,en}). No SGA source is used. Batch-5 flags: the closure of item plus new nodes equals the base closure (no new-only nodes). Every flagged citation was already used by the base. The reached trf nodes are generic and are not steps of the trace formula or Poincare duality: functorial flat resolutions, the pro-etale Leray chain formula, pullback stalk coherence, regular over a perfect field implies smooth. Accepted.
